Print the Results of a Spatial Cross-Validation

Source: R/auxiliary.R
print.RiskMap_cross_validation.Rd

Print method for objects of class "RiskMap_cross_validation" from assess_prediction. It gives the models, the test sets, how the parameters were set and the scores of each model averaged over the test sets. summary.RiskMap_cross_validation gives the scores of each test set, and plot.RiskMap_cross_validation maps the scores at the test locations and draws the calibration curve.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_cross_validation'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class "RiskMap_cross_validation".

...

Not used.

Value

Invisibly returns x.
